response.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COALESCE(SUM(t.amount), 0) AS account_total, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, account_total * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_total) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Transaction total means the sum of stored, unsigned transaction amounts. Accounts with no transactions have a total and count of zero.

alternatives.interpretation: Transaction total means net cash flow, treating the undocumented transaction type VYBER as a withdrawal.
alternatives.sql: WITH account_totals AS (SELECT a.account_id, d.A3 AS region, COALESCE(SUM(CASE t.type WHEN 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount WHEN 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount WHEN 'VYBER' THEN -t.amount END), 0) AS account_total, COUNT(t.trans_id) AS transaction_count FROM account AS a JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id LEFT JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3), shares AS (SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, account_total * 1.0 / NULLIF(SUM(account_total) OVER (PARTITION BY region), 0) AS share FROM account_totals) SELECT account_id, region, account_total, transaction_count, share FROM shares ORDER BY share IS NULL, share DESC, account_id LIMIT 10
